consequence.statement: These new Helm values are optional additions that enable new functionality without breaking existing deployments. Operators who do not use them experience no operational consequence.

assertion.statement: Three new Helm values (`webhook.extraEnv`, `cainjector.extraEnv`, and `startupapicheck.extraEnv`) were added to allow operators to set custom environment variables in their respective Pod containers.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The change bundles three distinct helm-value additions (webhook.extraEnv, cainjector.extraEnv, startupapicheck.extraEnv). Each should be analyzed as a separate subject, but the change presents them as a single statement.
